components.name: Agent Runtime
components.description: Managed execution environment for running AI agents on GPU-powered infrastructure. Handles orchestration, scaling, and lifecycle management for deployed agents.

components.name: Inference
components.description: Serverless access to foundation models (e.g. Llama, Mistral, GPT) via OpenAI-compatible API.

components.name: ADK
components.description: (Agent Development Kit) Open-source toolkit for building, testing, and deploying AI agents locally or in the cloud via CLI and SDK integrations.

components.name: Knowledge Bases
components.description: RAG-powered document stores that give agents access to your data. Supports multiple data sources for accurate, context-aware responses.

components.name: Guardrails
components.description: Content safety layer that filters agent inputs and outputs. Enforces topic restrictions and behavioral boundaries to keep agents on-task and compliant.

components.name: Model Services
components.description: Hosts and serves foundation and embedding models for serverless and dedicated inference workloads across the Gradient AI Platform.

incidents.name: Network Connectivity and Event Processing in FRA1
incidents.message:
Impact: minor;
Our Engineering team has confirmed full resolution of all issues in our FRA1 region. Confirmed impact timestamps are listed below for reference: 

Network connectivity: 12:34 - 12:45 UTC and 12:49 - 12:52 UTC
Event processing: 12:34 - 14:10 UTC

If you continue to experience problems, please open a ticket with our Support team. Thank you for your patience and we apologize for the inconvenience.

Affected Components: Services - Droplets Services - Event Processing Services - Load Balancers Services - Managed Databases Services - Networking Regions - FRA1 

Status: resolved
2022-10-28 17:11 UTC
-

Our Engineering team has taken action to resolve the event processing issues in FRA1, including Droplet creation and events on all Droplet-based services, like Load Balancers, Managed Kubernetes, Managed Databases, etc. 

The team has also observed continued network stability after the initial network outages from 12:34 - 12:45 UTC and 12:49-12:52 UTC. Additional mitigation has been put in place to prevent any further instability.

We are monitoring the situation and will post an update once we confirm the issue is fully resolved.

Affected Components: Services - Droplets Services - Event Processing Services - Load Balancers Services - Managed Databases Services - Networking Regions - FRA1 

Status: monitoring
2022-10-28 15:43 UTC
-

Our Engineering team is currently investigating an issue in our FRA1 region, causing widespread effect. Beginning 12:34 UTC, users may have seen network connectivity loss to Droplets and Droplet-based services, like Managed Kubernetes and  Database Clusters. We are seeing network connectivity restored, but continue to investigate the root cause.

Additionally, event processing in FRA1 is impacted. Users may see failures or latency when processing events in FRA1, including Droplet creation and events on all Droplet-based services, like Load Balancers, Managed Kubernetes, Managed Databases, etc. 

Thank you for your patience, we will share more information as soon as it's available.
